title: Lesson 38: Resolve FlexCard Display & State Issues
description: Resolve Flexcards display and state issues.

questions.question: A FlexCard renders blank. What is the FIRST diagnostic step?
options: Inspect the data JSON from its data source
questions.explanation: Start with the data JSON. Wrong shape/missing fields cause blanks.

questions.question: A card state never displays even though data exists. Likely cause?
options: The condition doesn't match actual data values
The card has no data source
The page is in a Community
questions.explanation: State conditions must evaluate true against live data.

questions.question: Which tool shows the request/response logs for the card's data source?
questions.explanation: The Debug Console captures request/response logs for OmniStudio components.
